name: SIM Network
author: chenshifanjian
description: Manage a 4G modem: live data usage and speed, SMS and MMS send/receive with desktop notifications, optional Obsidian archiving, GPS location, and an on-demand monthly data-quota check that sends one carrier SMS. Built and tested on Quectel EG25-G with China Telecom; receiving MMS needs mmsd-tng and the optional helpers are installed manually from extras/. The public-IP lookup is a manual single request to api64.ipify.org.
